messages.subject: Middle East Executive Profile | Energy Transition, Infrastructure, ESG & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear One Search Middle East Team,

Your Abu Dhabi-led executive-search work across infrastructure, energy transition and portfolio leadership in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Qatar aligns closely with my international profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where major investment, responsible development, institutional trust and cross-border execution intersect. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
